tips.li: Nixies need at least 25 psyfocus to use their innate psycasts, but they don't need a psylink.
In an emergency, Waterskip can create puddles to satisfy a nixie's need for wetness.
Nixies' innate psycasts can greatly increase their combat effectiveness, but watch out: hostile nixies will use them, too.
A psylink won't trigger bio-rejection in trogs, but a mechlink will.
